title: Room type
description: A kind of room, and the slots it provides. The union of real rooms is not truncated by the corroboration rule: a type that exists in one repo is recorded as `default: false`, because the map must be able to express every real room even where only one house has one.

default.description: True when Phase 1 may pre-populate this type for a new user. A `default: true` type must trace to source rooms in at least two different repos: this is a quality gate on what we assume on a stranger's behalf, not a coverage rule.

provides_slots.description: Slot names this type provides. Scope checking reads this.
